---
toc: false
repo-actions: false
format:
  html:
    css: home/index.css
    anchor-sections: false
    grid:
      sidebar-width: 0px
      body-width: 1250px
      margin-width: 200px
      gutter-width: 2em 
title-block-banner: none
listing:
  - id: testimonial-carousel
    template: home/testimonials-carousel-template.ejs
    contents: home/testimonials.yaml
  - id: news-card
    template: home/news-carousel-template.ejs
    contents: news/news
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: events-card
    template: home/events-carousel-template.ejs
    contents: events/events/*.qmd
    sort: "date desc"
include-in-header:
  - text: |
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
        <script src="assets/javascript/impact_counter.js" defer></script>
        <script src="assets/javascript/equalize_cards.js" defer></script>
